format.description: csv: the rows, amounts as plain decimals with an ASCII minus; xlsx: a workbook, amounts as number cells. Left out, xlsx.

from.description: The first day: needed for general_ledger and journals, which run over a range.

report.description: general_ledger: every account's lines over the range with the running balance; trial_balance: every account's balance at the end of the month that holds to; journals: every entry posted over the range, a row per line; fixed_assets: the register's cost, accumulated depreciation and net book value at to; receivables and payables: each open document and credit by customer or supplier at to.

to.description: The last day of the range, or the day the report is as at.
